about: Every d = 3 perturbative-HT macro printed in the final paper (commit a6772872), with its text in paper/numbers.tex, where it is printed and the check of make -f public.mk replay in code/lri_3d_c4_exact that recomputes it (public/replay_exact3d.py; rules in code/lri_3d_c4_exact/public/results_map.md). Unprinted d = 3 macros (HTpThreeLwin, HTpThreeLmax, HTpRatio<n>Three, HTpThreeGateL, HTpThreeGate, HTpThreeStates) are not listed; the HT_Pert note quotes some of them. Written by HT3dPert, 2026-10-19.
